access_vocabulary.bank: trajectory-bank states and labels (training exposure only, never read during search)
access_vocabulary.construction_e2: construction/e2 shard items (training data or contrast estimation, θ0)
access_vocabulary.dev_evaluation: real evaluation of the arm's own candidates on the full dev panel through the shared BudgetLedger (one bundle each; screens fractional; repeats 0)
access_vocabulary.episode_library: the episode's declared library subsample (primitive identities and recipes, θ0)
access_vocabulary.episode_pool: the seeded per-round candidate pool drawn from the episode subsample (§6.5.3 pool mode)
access_vocabulary.field: the shared base field at θ0 (support K-FAC + vocabulary rows), R0
access_vocabulary.own_dev_results: this arm's own dev results in this episode, from its own store (no other arm's)
access_vocabulary.r0_candidate_description: per-candidate R0 description: recipe, layers, doses, relative norms and the shared field's a/q features at θ0 (unsupported tensors marked, never 0)
access_vocabulary.statnn_predictor: the matched static comparator trained on the bank (R0 inference only)
access_vocabulary.steer_contrasts_all_layers: construction/e2 contrast directions at every layer (θ0)
access_vocabulary.support_penalty: the shared support penalty pen(c) (function of the candidate alone)
access_vocabulary.wm_predictor: the WM-E ensemble trained on the bank (R0 inference only)

bon_steering.draw: B distinct actions uniformly without replacement, seed arm_seed('bon_steering', e)

llm.truncation_rule: length stop or output tokens >= limit is a failure

lora_sft.checkpoint_rule: n = min(B, 32) evenly spaced steps, last = final step; each one dev bundle

pool.failure_rule: A truncated, over-token-cap, unparseable or invalid ranking is a failed round: no candidate from it is evaluated, the round's b bundles are forfeited (closed at used + forfeited = B), and there is no retry, repair or fallback ranking.

readers.output_contract: exactly one JSON object (one surrounding code fence allowed); ranking = >= b distinct pool ids; nothing repaired, defaulted or guessed
readers.scripted_rule:
Frozen rule, in key order: (1) shares a primitive with an own guard-breaching evaluation -> last; (2) more
    primitives shared with the best own feasible incumbent first; (3) more steps whose contrast matches the primary
    objective first; (4) larger orientation-signed field a on the primary first (unsupported last); (5) smaller
    summed relative norm; (6) id.

field.shared_spec: wme-grouped-field-v1 (support writers, K-FAC, wm.collect) + wme-vocab-row-field-v1 (vocabulary rows: lm_head projected_kfac, embed_tokens row_diagonal); unsupported tensors are marked, never 0; one field, shared by every arm

embed.name: row_diagonal
embed.rule: D[r, i] = sum_{p: t_p = r} delta_{p,i}^2 / n over every input position (n = valid positions); q = 1/2 sum D * d^2; one-hot K-FAC A is exactly diagonal, hidden coordinates diagonal by declaration

lm_head.name: projected_kfac
lm_head.rule: A = E[x x^T] (hidden^2); G_R = E[delta_R delta_R^T] over the declared rows R (|R|^2), the R-block of K-FAC G; q = 1/2 tr(G_R D_R A D_R^T); exact K-FAC for edits supported on R; raw factors

vocab_rows.declared_rows_rule: lm_head: union of the row sets of the lm_head row_scale bank roots; embed: union of the row sets of the embed_tokens row_scale bank roots plus the inert dead rows (controls.INERT_SPEC['dead_rows']); recorded as the DeclaredRows identity hash at bank build
vocab_rows.unsupported: signed = q = None, supported = False, with a reason; never 0
